name: ui-click
prompt: Single soft UI click, a short dry tap of a fingertip on a small wooden button, gentle and rounded, no reverb.

name: ui-select
prompt: Soft confirm blip, a mellow plucked kalimba note rising slightly, warm and friendly, very short decay.

name: build-place
prompt: Wooden building being set down: a solid low thud of a timber frame landing on packed dirt, with a brief creak of wood joints.

name: road-place
prompt: Gravel path being laid: a short scattering pour of small stones and sand onto the ground, gritty and dry.

name: demolish-crash
prompt: Small wooden structure collapsing: cracking planks, a muffled crash of timber and thatch tumbling down, dusty and low.

name: invalid-buzz
prompt: Dull error knock: two quick muted thumps on a hollow wooden box, flat and discouraging, no pitch glide.

name: coin-chime
prompt: A few small gold coins dropping into a coin purse, bright metallic clinks with a tiny jingle, light and cheerful.

name: order-fulfill
prompt: Trade order completed: a satisfying hand bell ding followed by the rustle of goods sacks being handed over, rewarding tone.

name: order-new
prompt: New trade order arriving: a quick paper unfurl and a single soft messenger bell note, crisp and attentive.

name: day-tick
prompt: Dawn marker: a single delicate tap on a small brass handbell, airy and quiet, like morning light arriving.

name: plant-grow
prompt: Crop sprouting: a soft leafy rustle with a faint upward chirp of a small bird, fresh and organic.

name: settler-leave
prompt: Resident departing: a soft sigh of wind through tall grass with a single low wooden door knock, wistful and subdued.

name: shortage-warn
prompt: Supply shortage warning: a low hollow wooden tocsin knock repeated twice slowly, somber and cautionary, no harshness.

name: victory-fanfare
prompt: Settlement victory: a short cheerful fanfare of wooden flutes and a hand drum roll ending on a bright bell, warm folk style.

name: defeat-drone
prompt: Settlement lost: a slow descending phrase on a low wooden flute over a soft muffled drum, melancholic but gentle.

name: achievement-unlock
prompt: Achievement unlocked: a sparkling glockenspiel arpeggio of four rising notes with a light shimmer, celebratory and bright.

name: pause-tap
prompt: Game paused: a single muted fingertip tap on a clay pot, soft and neutral, very short.

name: hint-sparkle
prompt: Hint revealed: a tiny glimmering chime, like a small glass bell flicked once, delicate and curious.
